out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located closest to the 3 vat sink is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HAND SINKS NEED TP BE AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AND PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION AFTER DEALING WITH RAW FOODS, ETC. PIC CLEARED OUT THE HAND SINK ALLOWING ALL EMPLOYEES ACCESS

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: RAW SHELL EGGS WERE BEING STORED ON A CART NEXT TO THE STOVE TOP WITH NO TEMPERATURE CONTROL.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT RAW SHELL EGGS ARE TO BE COLD HELD AT A TEMPERATURE OF 41F OR BELOW. PIC PUT SOME EGGS INTO A SMALLER CONTAINER, THEN PUT THAT CONTAINER INTO AN ICE BATH TO PLACE ON THE CART. THE EXTRA EGGS NOT IN THE CONTAINER IN THE ICE BATH, WERE PLACED IN THE 2DR UCR AVANTCO COOLER UNTIL THEY ARE NEEDED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. ANT AND ROACH RAID WAS FOUND IN STORAGE WITH CLEANING CHEMICALS.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HOME USE PESTICIDES CANNOT BE USED IN RESTAURANTS. A PEST CONTROL APPLICATOR IS ALSO THE PERSON WHO CAN SPRAY PEST CONTROL CHEMICALS IN RESTAURANTS. PIC THREW RAID AWAY.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: TWO KNIVES WERE BEGIN STORED IN THE GAP BETWEEN THE 2DR UCR AVANTCO COOLER AND THE 1DR 2DWR AVANTCO PREP TOP COOLER (RIGHT).
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC PROPER STORAGE OF IN-USE UTENSILS. CFM IS NOW AWARE IN-USE UTENSILS MUST BE STORED IN A LOCATION THAT CAN BE EASILY WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED. PIC MOVED KNIVES TO 3VAT SINK TO GET WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED BEFORE USING AGAIN.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: the ice machine in facility was dirty with black and pink mold.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE ICE MACHINE NEEDS TO BE CLEANED ON A REGULAR BASIS TO PREVENT THE BUILD UP OF MOLD. PIC WILL CLEAN ICD MACHINE BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: sugar and rice were being stored in large white food safe containers, that were dirty to sight and touch.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE STORAGE CONTAINERS USED FOR RICE AND SUAGR NEED TO BE DEEP CLEANED. OIC WILL CLEAN STORAGE CONTAINERS BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Multi-Use Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth/Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surface of the following equipment contains cracks, chips, or pits and can not be easily cleaned: multiple cutting boards had deep groves in them, making them unable to be properly washed, rinsed and sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Multiuse food-contact surfaces shall be: 1) smooth, 2) free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, inclusions, pits, and similar imperfections, 3) free of sharp integral angles, corners, and crevices, 4) finished to have smooth welds and joints, and 5) accessible for cleaning and inspection. Cleaning and inspection shall be completed by one of the following methods: (a) without being disassembled, (b). by disassembling without the use of tools, or (c) by easy disassembling with the use of handheld tools. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY THE CUTTING BOARDS NEED TO BE CHANGED OUT WITH NEW ONES. PIC WAS ABLE TO ORDER NEW CUTTING BOARDS BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION AND WILL HAVE NEW ONES BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors underneath the grill and fryers are in need of deep cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE FLOORS UNDER THE GRILL NEED TO BE CLEANED. LOTS OF BUILD UP AND DEBRIS WAS UNDER THE GRILL, MAKING IT A POTENTIALLY SAFETY HAZARD. PIC WILL CLEAN UNDER THE GRILL AND FRYERS BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION. SUGAR PALM THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 07/17/2025) Page 2 of 3
